args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. We rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in every region and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it, and review why it went to production when the RC had been unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. I moved us-east, us-west and eu-west back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Afterwards the service reports healthy in every region and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) is open, and opening it paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also lists two next steps: find out why v2.3.1 broke before redeploying it, and look into why it reached production when its test build (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed health checks in staging.
